name: Todos
description: Checkbox lines with todo.txt-style tokens: due:2026-10-01, start:, rec:monthly, until:, times:, !high, @person, #tag. Each token is a chip that opens its own editor; ⌘. opens a task's fields. Show todos and ::tasks list them from across your notes.

files:read.why: List tasks from every note in the Todos view and ::tasks lists

files:write.why: Tick tasks and change their details from the Todos view and ::tasks lists

editor.why: Draw tasks as checkboxes and chips in notes, and complete their tokens

commands.title: Task fields: priority, due, repeat, person, tags

embeds.title: Task list
embeds.description: Tasks (- [ ] lines) from across your notes, gathered live and grouped by note, due date, priority, tag or person. Tick one here and it's ticked in its note; click a chip to change it.

folder.description: Only notes in this folder, like Projects

tag.description: Only tasks with this tag (and the tags under it), like work

assignee.label: Person
assignee.description: Only this person's tasks, like jane

limit.description: At most this many, then Show more

todos.chips.description: Show a task's tokens as chips ("Tomorrow", "Monthly", "High") on lines the cursor isn't on.
